## 1. Evidence or guess?

{{< vocab "evidence" text="Evidence" zh=true >}} is something archaeologists found and can check. A guess is an idea about what it means. Write each letter in the right column.

:::: {layout-ncol=2}
::: {}

**B.** The pillars show the builders' gods.\

## 2. Put them in order

Number from 1 (oldest) to 5 (newest).

☐ The Colosseum is finished in Rome\
☐ Göbekli Tepe is built\
☐ The Parthenon is built in Athens\
☐ The Great Pyramid is built in Egypt\
☐ Rome becomes a republic

{{< pagebreak >}}

## 3. Explain the change

At first, archaeologists said Göbekli Tepe was a temple where nobody lived. Now most think people lived there too. What new evidence changed their minds? Name **two** things.

*Archaeologists changed their minds because they found …*

{{< lines 5 >}}

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
{{< pagebreak >}}

::: {.callout-note title="Answer key"}
**1.** Evidence: A, C, E, G, I. Guess: B, D, F, H, J. (D was the first team's idea; the houses and water tanks found later count against it.)

**2.** 1 Göbekli Tepe (about 9500 BC); 2 the Great Pyramid (about 2560 BC); 3 Rome becomes a republic (509 BC); 4 the Parthenon (447–432 BC); 5 the Colosseum (AD 80).

**3.** Any two of: remains of houses; rainwater tanks (cisterns) holding at least 150,000 liters; thousands of grinding stones and tools for preparing food every day. Strong answers say *why* it matters: people need water and food where they live.
:::
:::
